Lemon - Pie Filling Mix
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 8, 2009 - 11:11pm

Ingredients




2 1/2 cups presweetened powdered lemonade mix
1 cup plus 2 tbsp. cornstarch
1 1/4 cups sugar, more for sweeter flavor
1 teaspoon salt

Preparation

1 In a medium bowl, combine lemonade mix, cornstarch, sugar and salt. Mix well. Put in a 1 quart airtight container. Label. Store in a cool, dry place. Use within 6 to 8 months. Makes 4 1/4 cups of filling mix.
